# class coverage tags (not new classification of source — coverage bookkeeping)
def coverage_tags(ln):
    tags=[]
    if ln in H91: tags.append("H91_KR11")
    if ln in TR008: tags.append("TR008_COMMENT_HASH")
    if ln in TR003_H1: tags.append("TR003_H1_PAU")
    if ln in PASS_H2: tags.append("HEADING_PASS")
    if ln in NESTED_H23: tags.append("NESTED_H2H3")
    if ln in FENCE_MARKERS: tags.append("FENCE_MARKER")
    if ln in VERBATIM_MARKERS: tags.append("VERBATIM_MARKER")
    if ln in DECLARED: tags.append("DECLARED_VERBATIM")
    if ln in ASCII_LINES: tags.append("ASCII_DELIMITER")
    if ln in HR_BLANK: tags.append("HR_OR_BLANK")
    if ln in KV_LINES: tags.append("KV")
    if ln in PROSE: tags.append("PROSE_STOP")
    if ln in LIST_ITEM: tags.append("LIST")
    if ln in TABLE: tags.append("TABLE")
    if ln in IN_VERB_H2: tags.append("IN_VERBATIM_H2")
    if ln in (30613,30614,30615,30616,30617): tags.append("SUPPLEMENT_BOUNDARY")
    if ln >= 30860: tags.append("DOCUMENT_TAIL")
    return tags

# DeclaredVerbatimBody TR-016
for dln in DECLARED:
    # body until next ASCII section or PAU end
    pau = pau_for_line(dln)
    end = pau["end"] if pau else n
    body_end = end
    for j in range(dln, end):  # 0-index j
        # j is 1-based walk from next line
        pass
    # next ASCII after declaration
    body_end_1b = pau["end"] if pau else n
    for j in range(dln, (pau["end"] if pau else n)):
        s = stripped(j)
        if len(s) >= 8 and set(s) == {"-"}:
            body_end_1b = j  # exclusive? "until next ASCII" — ASCII line starts next child; body ends before it
            break
        if len(s) >= 8 and set(s) == {"="}:
            body_end_1b = j

    # declaration is dln; body dln+1 .. body_end_1b-1; include declaration in phrase
    start_off = byte_offsets[dln-1]
    # raw_text=body without synthetic markers: body after declaration
    if body_end_1b > dln:

        bstart, bend = dln, dln
    add(Rec(
        seq=0, record_type="DeclaredVerbatimBody", transform_rule="TR-016",
        source_start=dln, source_end=max(dln, bend if body_end_1b > dln else dln),

# ---- per-line forward for corpus ----

for ln in corpus_lines:
    i = ln-1
    rawl = body(i)
    exact = line_bytes(i)  # with newline
    s = stripped(i)
    vname = vmask[i]
    fid = fence_id_at[i]
    pau = pau_for_line(ln)
    pau_id = pau["pau_id"] if pau else None
    in_v = vname is not None

    # occupancy-only: blank / exact HR ---  (KR-8, KR-9)
    if s == "":
        occupancy_only_lines.append(ln)
        add(Rec(
            seq=0, record_type="OccupancyOnly", transform_rule="KR-9",
            source_start=ln, source_end=ln,
            raw_text=None,  # explicitly NOT stored per KR-9 "erzeugen keine Records"
            parent_id=pau_id, pau_id=pau_id, fence_id=fid,
            in_fence=in_f, in_pau=pau is not None, in_verbatim=in_v,
            occupancy_only=True,

            notes="KR-9: blank creates no content record; raw_text not independently reconstructable",

    if s == "---":

        add(Rec(

            source_start=ln, source_end=ln,
            raw_text=None,
            parent_id=pau_id, pau_id=pau_id, fence_id=fid,

            notes="KR-8: --- is delimiter not heading/PAU; no content record with raw_text",
        ))

        continue

    # TR-015 marker lines: also per-line identity with exact raw_text
    if begin_line_re.match(s) or (end_line_re.match(s) and not s.startswith("END_TO_END")):
        parent, pau_id2, vid = occupancy_parent(ln)
        add(Rec(
            seq=0, record_type="AddressableStatement", transform_rule="TR-015",
            source_start=ln, source_end=ln,
            raw_text=exact,

        continue

    # Inside opaque marked verbatim: no operative heading/PAU/KR-11 (KR-1, TR-006 context)

    if in_v and not (begin_line_re.match(s) or (end_line_re.match(s) and not s.startswith("END_TO_END"))):
        # covered by MarkedVerbatimRegion; per-line content record not required
        parent, pau_id2, vid = occupancy_parent(ln)
        add(Rec(
            seq=0, record_type="VerbatimOccupancyCoveredLine", transform_rule="KR-1",
            source_start=ln, source_end=ln,
            raw_text=None,  # reconstruct from parent region raw_span_bytes, not stored per-line
            parent_id=parent, pau_id=pau_id, fence_id=fid,

            in_fence=in_f, in_pau=pau is not None, in_verbatim=True,
            occupancy_only=False,
            authority_status="NONE",
            notes="KR-1 opaque occupancy; raw recoverable from MarkedVerbatimRegion.raw_span_bytes only",

        continue

    # TR-003 match → PAU start line identity (raw_heading already on PAU; also store line raw_text here)
    tr003_kind = is_pau_start_abcdeg(i, False)
    is_pau_start_here = pau is not None and pau["start"]==ln
    atx_m = atx_re.match(rawl)
    heading_level = len(atx_m.group(1)) if atx_m else None

    if is_pau_start_here and (tr003_kind or pau["kind"] in ("f_PASS_H2","h_POST_LAST_VERBATIM","d_ASCII_GATE2","g_BEGIN_VERBATIM")):
        add(Rec(
            seq=0, record_type="PhysicalAppendUnitStartLine", transform_rule="TR-003",
            source_start=ln, source_end=ln,
            raw_text=exact,
            raw_heading=rawl,
            parent_id=None,
            pau_id=pau_id,
            fence_id=fid,
            in_fence=in_f, in_pau=True, in_verbatim=in_v,
            heading_level=heading_level,
            physical_order=pau["physical_order"] if pau else None,
            authority_status="NONE",
            classification=None,
            representation_form=None,
            notes=f"kind={pau['kind']}",
        ))
        typed_lines.setdefault(ln, []).append(records[-1].seq)
        # ## PASS= that is TR-003(f) is PAU start, not also leftover
        # if also ## PASS= as heading facet of this new unit? TR-003(f) line IS the PAU start; PassNameFacet also TR-021
        if s.startswith("## PASS="):
            add(Rec(
                seq=0, record_type="PassNameFacet", transform_rule="TR-021",
                source_start=ln, source_end=ln,
                raw_text=exact,
                raw_heading=rawl,
                parent_id=pau_id, pau_id=pau_id, fence_id=fid,
                in_fence=in_f, in_pau=True, in_verbatim=False,
                facet_kind="HEADING_PASS",
                heading_level=2,
                authority_status="NONE",
            ))
            typed_lines.setdefault(ln, []).append(records[-1].seq)
        continue

    # ATX heading path: TR-003 miss → TR-008 → KR-11 for level 1; TR-006 for >=2 / PASS
    if atx_m:
        level = heading_level
        # TR-008
        if comment_hash_re.match(s):
            parent, pau_id2, vid = occupancy_parent(ln)
            add(Rec(
                seq=0, record_type="AddressableStatement", transform_rule="TR-008",
                source_start=ln, source_end=ln,
                raw_text=exact,
                raw_key=None, raw_value=None,
                classification=None,  # TR-008 does not set CLASSIFICATION
                representation_form="COMMENT_HASH",
                parent_id=parent, pau_id=pau_id, fence_id=fid,
                in_fence=in_f, in_pau=pau is not None, in_verbatim=in_v,
                heading_level=level,
                authority_status="NONE",
                creates_new_parent=False,

            typed_lines.setdefault(ln, []).append(records[-1].seq)
            continue
        # ## PASS= TR-006 / TR-021
        if s.startswith("## PASS="):
            parent, pau_id2, vid = occupancy_parent(ln)
            add(Rec(
                seq=0, record_type="PassNameFacet", transform_rule="TR-021",
                source_start=ln, source_end=ln,
                raw_text=exact,
                raw_heading=rawl,
                parent_id=pau_id, pau_id=pau_id, fence_id=fid,
                in_fence=in_f, in_pau=pau is not None, in_verbatim=in_v,
                facet_kind="HEADING_PASS",
                heading_level=2,
                authority_status="NONE",
                creates_new_parent=False,
            ))
            typed_lines.setdefault(ln, []).append(records[-1].seq)
            continue
        # leftover ATX level-1: KR-11 (form ^#[ \t]+ after TR-003 miss and TR-008 miss)
        if level == 1 and kr11_form_re.match(s):
            parent, pau_id2, vid = occupancy_parent(ln, for_kr11=True)
            add(Rec(
                seq=0, record_type="AddressableStatement", transform_rule="KR-11",
                source_start=ln, source_end=ln,
                raw_text=exact,
                raw_key=SENTINEL_NULL, raw_value=SENTINEL_NULL,
                classification="UNRESOLVED",
                representation_form=SENTINEL_NULL,
                parent_id=parent, pau_id=pau_id, fence_id=fid,
                in_fence=in_f, in_pau=pau is not None, in_verbatim=in_v,
                heading_level=1,
                unresolved_status="UNRESOLVED",
                epistemic_status=None,  # NOT silently equated to classification
                authority_status="NONE",
                creates_new_parent=False,
                notes="KR-11 leftover ATX-H1; PARENTAGE=existing occupancy only",
            ))
            typed_lines.setdefault(ln, []).append(records[-1].seq)
            continue
        # heading_level >= 2 → NestedStructuralChild (now-governing TR-006)
        if level is not None and level >= 2:
            parent, pau_id2, vid = occupancy_parent(ln)
            add(Rec(
                seq=0, record_type="NestedStructuralChild", transform_rule="TR-006",
                source_start=ln, source_end=ln,
                raw_text=exact,
                raw_heading=rawl,
                parent_id=parent, pau_id=pau_id, fence_id=fid,
                in_fence=in_f, in_pau=pau is not None, in_verbatim=in_v,
                heading_level=level,
                delimiter_form="ATX_HEADING",
                authority_status="NONE",
                creates_new_parent=False,
                child_id=f"nsc:{ln}",
            ))
            typed_lines.setdefault(ln, []).append(records[-1].seq)
            continue

    # TR-007 ASCII
    if len(s) >= 8 and set(s) == {"="}:
        parent, pau_id2, vid = occupancy_parent(ln)
        # if this line is PAU start d_ASCII, already continued above; here inner ASCII children
        add(Rec(
            seq=0, record_type="NestedStructuralChild", transform_rule="TR-007",
            source_start=ln, source_end=ln,
            raw_text=exact,
            raw_heading=rawl,
            parent_id=pau_id, pau_id=pau_id, fence_id=fid,
            in_fence=in_f, in_pau=pau is not None, in_verbatim=in_v,
            delimiter_form="ASCII_EQUALS",
            authority_status="NONE",
        ))
        typed_lines.setdefault(ln, []).append(records[-1].seq)
        continue
    if len(s) >= 8 and set(s) == {"-"} and s != "---":
        add(Rec(
            seq=0, record_type="NestedStructuralChild", transform_rule="TR-007",
            source_start=ln, source_end=ln,
            raw_text=exact,
            raw_heading=rawl,
            parent_id=pau_id, pau_id=pau_id, fence_id=fid,
            in_fence=in_f, in_pau=pau is not None, in_verbatim=in_v,
            delimiter_form="ASCII_DASHES",
            authority_status="NONE",
        ))
        typed_lines.setdefault(ln, []).append(records[-1].seq)
        continue

    # TR-009 fence markers (```)
    if s.startswith("```"):
        parent, pau_id2, vid = occupancy_parent(ln)
        add(Rec(
            seq=0, record_type="AddressableStatement", transform_rule="TR-009",
            source_start=ln, source_end=ln,
            raw_text=exact,
            raw_heading=rawl,
            parent_id=fid or parent, pau_id=pau_id, fence_id=fid,
            in_fence=True, in_pau=pau is not None, in_verbatim=in_v,
            delimiter_form="FENCED_CODE_MARKER",
            representation_form=None,
            authority_status="NONE",
            notes="opening/closing marker exact; fence NestedStructuralChild holds span",
        ))
        typed_lines.setdefault(ln, []).append(records[-1].seq)
        continue

    # TR-012 table
    if s.startswith("|"):
        parent, pau_id2, vid = occupancy_parent(ln)
        add(Rec(
            seq=0, record_type="MatrixRow", transform_rule="TR-012",
            source_start=ln, source_end=ln,
            raw_text=exact,
            parent_id=parent, pau_id=pau_id, fence_id=fid,
            in_fence=in_f, in_pau=pau is not None, in_verbatim=in_v,
            authority_status="NONE",
            notes="raw_row=exact line; no DataFrame collapse",
        ))
        typed_lines.setdefault(ln, []).append(records[-1].seq)
        continue

    # TR-013 list
    if list_re.match(s):
        parent, pau_id2, vid = occupancy_parent(ln)
        add(Rec(
            seq=0, record_type="AddressableStatement", transform_rule="TR-013",
            source_start=ln, source_end=ln,
            raw_text=exact,
            parent_id=parent, pau_id=pau_id, fence_id=fid,
            in_fence=in_f, in_pau=pau is not None, in_verbatim=in_v,
            representation_form="LIST_ITEM",
            authority_status="NONE",
        ))
        typed_lines.setdefault(ln, []).append(records[-1].seq)
        continue

    # TR-010 KEY=VALUE
    km = kv_re.match(s)
    if km and not s.startswith("|") and not s.startswith("#"):
        parent, pau_id2, vid = occupancy_parent(ln)
        key, val = km.group(1), km.group(2)
        occ = kv_occurrence(key, pau_id, ln)
        add(Rec(
            seq=0, record_type="AddressableStatement", transform_rule="TR-010",
            source_start=ln, source_end=ln,
            raw_text=exact,
            raw_key=key, raw_value=val,
